title: SuperTag PermissionSet manifest
description: A PermissionSet manifest, as supertag apply -f reads it. Its spec is supertag.operator.v1.PermissionSetSpec in supertag/operator/v1/resource.proto; this file is generated from it.

name.description: The resource's name, unique within its kind.

PermissionSetSpec.description: A Permission Set's declared permissions, and the `spec` of a `PermissionSet` manifest. Apply merges approvers and permissions entry by entry; a permission is keyed by its target, scope or resource, and action.

approvers.description: Who may decide its gated permissions: `operator:OPERATOR_ID` or `tag:TAG`, by name or ID. Repeated entries count once.

Permission.description: One permission. In a manifest it is `target` beside the target's fields, `action` and `approval`.

oneOf.description: An action on a collaboration surface through one Surface Account.

scope.description: Where on the account, such as a channel or `owner/repo`.

reference.description: A canonical, non-secret locator for the resource, used to pick the target when a request names it.

action.description: The action, such as `commands:execute`, `issues:comment`, or for MCP `server/tool`, where the tool may be `*`.

approval.description: Whether using it needs a decision first.

oneOf.description: A harness or runtime capability, such as `commands:execute`.

resource.description: Limits the grant to calls whose arguments name this resource, for servers with a resource mapping. Empty: any call.
